:::{#rem-smooth-function-loose}
#### "Smooth" in statistics and machine learning

Statistics and machine learning texts often use "smooth" loosely,
for a function with as many derivatives as the argument at hand needs,
usually two.
A cubic spline, for example, is called smooth
although its third derivative jumps at each knot,
so it is not smooth in the sense of @def-smooth-function.
When an argument depends on the number of derivatives,
name that number ("twice-differentiable") rather than saying "smooth".

:::
